sections.heading: Where do Standard Level physics students actually lose marks?
paragraphs: In four places, and almost always the same four: definitions reproduced without understanding, multi-step problems abandoned at the first step, graphs read carelessly, and explanation questions answered with a formula. A Standard Level student who fixes those four moves up without learning a single new piece of physics, which is why the first job of a tutor is to find out which of the four is costing the most.

The reproduced definition is the quietest of the four because it looks like competence. A student writes a textbook sentence about acceleration perfectly and then cannot say whether an object slowing down has a positive or negative acceleration, or what the sign means physically. The definition was memorised as a string of words rather than as a statement about the world. The test for this is simple and uncomfortable: ask the student to explain the same idea twice, once in the textbook words and once to a younger sibling. If the second version does not exist, the first one is decoration.

The abandoned multi-step problem is the most visible. The question needs three moves, the student makes the first, cannot see the second, and stops. What has usually failed is not physics but planning: nobody taught the student to write down what they have, what they want, and which relationship connects the two before touching the numbers. Three lines of planning at the top of the answer space turns a blank half-page into partial credit, and partial credit across a paper is worth more than one perfect question.

Careless graph reading costs marks in both the data analysis paper and the written one. Students read a gradient without checking what the axes represent, take a value off the line where they should have used a data point, ignore the scale prefix, or calculate a gradient from two points that are not on the line of best fit. None of this is difficulty. It is speed, and it is fixed by making the student narrate the axes out loud before touching the graph.

The explain answered with a formula is the costliest of the four. The question asks why a quantity changes and the student writes the equation and the number. The equation earns what the equation earns and the rest of the marks sit unclaimed in the sentence that was never written. The fix is drilling causal chains: because this increased, that decreased, which means this third thing happened. Three linked clauses, written in order. Students resist it because it feels like English homework, and it is worth more marks per minute than anything else in the subject.

sections.heading: Two students sit in every Standard Level class and need opposite things
paragraphs: The first is the student who found International General Certificate of Secondary Education (IGCSE) physics genuinely hard and chose Standard Level to survive the sciences requirement. The gaps are real and they are underneath everything: rearranging an equation with the unknown in the denominator, reading a scale prefix, holding the difference between mass and weight, knowing what a negative sign means on a velocity. This student needs foundations rebuilt, slowly, and needs a tutor willing to spend a session on algebra without apologising for it. Progress here is slow for the first month and then accelerates, because every topic afterwards stops costing double.

The second is the student who could have managed Higher Level and is coasting. They understand the lessons, they do not revise, they attempt homework in the ten minutes before the bus, and they sit on a 5 that everybody including them regards as fine. This student needs the opposite treatment: no reteaching, no patient explanation, just harder questions under time pressure and a tutor who refuses to accept an answer that would lose marks even though it is basically right. Patient explanation makes this student worse, because it confirms that the hour is somewhere to be carried.

Getting the diagnosis the wrong way round is the most common failure in Standard Level tutoring, and it burns a term. Pushing the first student with timed papers produces panic and a student who decides they are bad at physics. Patiently reteaching the second produces boredom and a parent paying for an hour of agreement. A good tutor knows which one is in front of them inside two sessions, and will say so plainly rather than running the same lesson plan on both.

What progress looks like differs by student and the honest timeline does not. At four weeks, expect a change in behaviour rather than grade: attempts where there were blanks, planning lines at the top of long answers, a student who says what the question is asking before answering it. At one term, roughly twelve to fourteen sessions, a grade movement is reasonable if technique was the limiting factor, and slower if foundations were. Across one examination cycle, the measure is whether the student walks into the mock hall with a method.

The limits are worth saying out loud. IB Gram does not guarantee grades, because the result depends on what the student does in the six days between sessions, on how early the family started, and on circumstances neither tutor nor platform controls. If six weeks pass with no change in how the student approaches a question, the answer is to change the approach or the tutor, not to buy more hours of the same thing.

sections.heading: Booking an IB DP Physics SL tutor in Mumbai: the first two sessions
paragraphs: Have four things ready: the two most recent marked Physics assessments with the examiner or teacher comments intact, the latest subject report, the school's assessment calendar, and the student's own view of which topics they would skip if allowed to. That last one is free and more accurate than the report. Students know exactly which topic they have been avoiding since September, and they will usually say so if asked without a parent in the room.

Session one is a diagnostic and should look like it. The student works a past paper question out loud while the tutor keeps quiet and watches where the hesitation lands. There is a short conversation about method rather than content. The tutor should finish the hour able to tell you which of the four standard failure modes is costing the most, and you should get that in writing within a day or two rather than as a reassuring sentence at the door.

Session two is where teaching starts, and the shape of it tells you whether the diagnosis was real. A student diagnosed with a planning problem should spend the second hour planning answers rather than learning new content. A student diagnosed with foundation gaps should spend it on the gaps, even if that means an hour of algebra with no physics in it. If session two looks exactly like a school lesson regardless of what session one found, the diagnosis was decorative.

faqs.question: Is Standard Level physics easier than Higher Level?
faqs.answer: There is less content, but the standard expected of a written answer is the same. A Standard Level student who answers an explain question with a formula loses the same marks a Higher Level student would lose for doing it. The difference is the volume of material and how far a question pushes a chain of reasoning, not the quality of communication the examiner wants. This is why a Standard Level student can understand the physics, work hard and still sit on a 4. The understanding is not the thing being measured on its own; the written answer is.

faqs.question: My child says they understand physics but keeps getting a 4. What is happening?
faqs.answer: Usually they understand the lesson and cannot reproduce it under examination conditions, which is a different skill. The common cause is definitions memorised as strings of words rather than as statements about the world. Ask them to explain the same idea twice, once in textbook words and once to a younger child. If the second version does not exist, the first was decoration. A Physics tutor in Mumbai working with this student should spend the early sessions on explanation and planning rather than reteaching content the student can already recite back correctly.

faqs.question: My child stops after the first line of long questions. Why?
faqs.answer: Because nobody taught them to plan, not because they lack the physics. A three-step question needs the student to write down what they have, what they want, and which relationship connects the two before any number is touched. Students who skip that step make the first move, cannot see the second, and stop. Three lines of planning at the top of the answer space converts a blank half page into partial credit, and partial credit collected across a whole paper is worth more than one immaculate question. It takes about three sessions to make the habit stick.

faqs.question: Our child is coasting in Standard Level and could have done Higher Level. What should a tutor do?
faqs.answer: Give them harder questions under time pressure and refuse answers that would lose marks even when they are basically right. Patient reteaching makes this student worse, because it confirms the hour is somewhere to be carried rather than somewhere to work. What usually moves a coasting Standard Level student is a tutor who marks strictly, sets timed sections, and makes them rewrite an answer that earned four marks when it should have earned six. Expect some friction in the first fortnight. A student used to being told they are fine does not enjoy the first honest marking.

faqs.question: How many sessions a week does a Standard Level student need?
faqs.answer: One well-used session a week is enough for most students, with a second added in the eight weeks before mocks. More than two is almost always a scheduling mistake rather than an academic decision, because Physics improves through the work done between sessions and a student with three tutoring hours has less time to do it. The exception is a student rebuilding foundations in DP1, where two shorter sessions often beat one long one. Ask the tutor to justify any recommendation above two hours a week, and treat a vague answer as a selling answer.

faqs.question: Where in the home should a session happen if there is no study room?
faqs.answer: Not much, as long as the surface is big enough for two people and a past paper. The dining table works better than a bedroom desk for home tuition in Mumbai flats, because an adult passing through occasionally keeps a session honest and the lighting is usually better. What does matter is the television being off and the younger sibling being elsewhere for the hour. In the compact two-bedroom flats common in Chembur, Mulund West and Vile Parle, families usually settle on the dining table and shift dinner by an hour, which works fine.

faqs.question: What happens if an evening session is missed because of the monsoon?
faqs.answer: Agree the rule before it happens rather than after. The usual arrangement is that a session cancelled with reasonable notice is rescheduled, and a session where the tutor is caught in traffic runs short or moves rather than being charged in full. July and August matter here: a tutor travelling to Powai or along Ghodbunder Road in heavy rain will lose a slot or two over the monsoon, and the families who cope best agree a standing online fallback for those evenings instead of simply cancelling. Put the rule in a message, not a conversation.

faqs.question: Does online tutoring work for Standard Level Physics?
faqs.answer: It works on two conditions and fails without them. The tutor needs a graphics tablet so they can write on the student's own working instead of describing corrections, and the student has to photograph their attempt and send it before the session so the hour opens on real mistakes. With both in place, an IB online tutor in Mumbai covers planning, command terms and graph work as effectively as a home session. Without them an online hour becomes a lecture, which is the format a Standard Level student benefits from least, because the problem is rarely that nobody explained it.

faqs.question: The tutor is pleasant but nothing is changing. What do we do?
faqs.answer: Ask for the diagnosis in writing, and if there is not one, change tutors. A pleasant hour with no written view of what is actually going wrong is the most common way a term disappears. The question to ask directly is which of the four standard failure modes the tutor thinks is costing the most marks, and what the plan is for the next four weeks. A tutor who cannot answer in specifics has been running generic lessons. IB Gram arranges a replacement without requiring you to justify it beyond describing what is not happening.

faqs.question: We are in Navi Mumbai. Can we actually get a Standard Level Physics specialist?
faqs.answer: Yes, and the match works best node to node rather than across the creek. Tutors are matched within Vashi, Nerul, Seawoods, Belapur, Kharghar and Panvel, moving along Palm Beach Road and the Sion Panvel Highway, because a tutor pulled from the island city for a weekday evening rarely holds the slot past the first term. The Atal Setu has improved that crossing, but it has not made it a sensible weekly commitment at 6pm. If the bench in your node is thin for Standard Level Physics, hybrid solves it properly.

faqs.question: When should we start, and is DP2 too late?
faqs.answer: Start in DP1 if the choice is yours, and the best single moment is right after the April end-of-year examinations when there is a full-length script to read. Starting in DP2 still works, but the work changes from building understanding to examination triage: planning long answers, drilling command terms, making sure nothing is left blank. A home tutor for Physics in Mumbai beginning in November can still move a Standard Level grade through technique alone. Rebuilding two years of foundations in that window cannot be done, and any tutor saying otherwise is selling hours.

faqs.question: How do we choose between the tutors you send us?
faqs.answer: Ask all of them the same question and compare the answers rather than the credentials. The question is what they would do in the first hour with a student who understands the physics and scores a 4. A tutor who says they would revise the topics has not understood the problem. A tutor who says they would watch the student answer a question and look at where the marks are lost has. sections.heading: How IB Gram arranges IB DP Psychology home tuition in Mumbai
paragraphs: The students who need IB DP Psychology home tuition in Mumbai usually do not need the course re-taught. They need somebody to sit beside them while they write an answer badly, stop them halfway, and ask what the command term at the front of the question told them to do. That is a different hire from a subject explainer, and it is the hire we try to make. Before suggesting anyone we ask for the year group, the Higher Level (HL) or Standard Level (SL) decision, the options the school teaches, and, most usefully of all, a recent marked script with the teacher's comments still on it.

What follows is four steps and no sales call. 1. You send those details plus two or three weekly windows that will survive a real term in this city. 2. We shortlist tutors who have taught Psychology across a full International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma Programme (DP) cycle, who live inside a travel radius they can actually sustain, and who are willing to mark against the published criteria rather than by instinct. 3. The tutor runs a paid first session in your home, working on the marked script you sent rather than on a topic. 4. You keep them or you tell us what was missing and a second shortlist follows.

The first session should feel slightly uncomfortable, and parents should be warned about that in advance. A tutor doing this properly will find the exact sentence where a student stopped answering the question and started writing what they remembered. Students who have been praised for knowing a lot of content find that moment unpleasant, and it is also the moment the tuition starts being worth paying for. If the first session ends with the student feeling flattered and nothing on paper has been rewritten, the tutor has been polite instead of useful.

Replacements are routine and nobody needs to be embarrassed about asking. A tutor who is excellent with a quiet DP1 student can be wrong for an argumentative DP2 student, and the mismatch is nobody's fault. Message us with the specific problem, not a general dissatisfaction, because specifics make the second shortlist better: too much talking, no written work set, arrives late, marks generously, cannot explain why a paragraph lost marks. There is no notice period and no fee for changing.

Shortlists built from tutors who mark to published criteria
First session works on the student's own script, not a fresh topic
Travel radius checked so the slot survives past November
Specific complaints produce better replacement shortlists than general ones

sections.heading: DP1, DP2 and the point where technique starts to matter more than content
paragraphs: Across the two years of the Diploma Programme, the thing that limits a Psychology grade changes. In the first half of DP1 it is content: the student does not yet know enough to write anything. Somewhere around the second term that flips, and for most students it never flips back. From then on the limiting factor is technique, meaning the ability to select, to structure, and to stop writing. Parents who book help late almost always booked it because a mock score came in low, and almost always discover the content was never the problem.

Higher Level and Standard Level differ in the number of components sat and in the depth of material covered, with Higher Level candidates taking an additional paper. The exact composition of each paper is set by the current subject guide and the IB updates its guides on its own schedule, so take the structure for your child's examination session from the school's DP coordinator or the current guide rather than from any page on the internet. What a family can plan around without any guide is the principle: more marks attached to a question means more development expected, and every paper rewards answering the actual instruction.

The core sits alongside all of this and competes for the same evenings. Theory of Knowledge (TOK) deadlines, the Extended Essay (EE) if the student has chosen one, and creativity, activity, service commitments all land in the same terms as the Psychology work. A good Psychology IB Diploma Programme (DP), Years 1-2 tutor Mumbai families book will ask about those other deadlines in the first conversation, because a tuition plan that ignores the EE submission window will be abandoned in the week it matters.

There is one more structural point worth knowing. Psychology attracts students who are strong readers and weak at being brief. The subject rewards precision and penalises padding, so the student who writes three pages of accurate material and answers a different question than the one asked will score below the student who writes a tight page on the right one. Home tuition is well suited to fixing this, because the tutor can make the student cut their own work in front of them, which nobody does voluntarily.
bullets: Content limits the grade in early DP1; technique limits it after that
Higher Level adds a further paper and further depth of material
Confirm the current component structure with your school's DP coordinator

sections.heading: What do Papers 1, 2 and 3 actually ask a student to do?
paragraphs: Paper 1 asks the student to work with the approaches to behaviour, Paper 2 asks them to write at length on the options their school teaches, and Paper 3, sat by Higher Level candidates, asks them to think like a researcher about an unseen piece of work. Three different demands, three different kinds of practice, and a tutor who drills only essay writing has prepared the student for one of them.

The approaches, biological, cognitive and sociocultural, are not three topics to be learned in sequence. They are three explanations competing to account for the same behaviour, and the examination rewards a student who can hold them against each other. In practice this shows up in the short-answer work, where the precision demanded is unusual: a question asking for an outline wants something compact and complete, and a student who writes a paragraph of background before reaching the point has spent time they will need later in the paper. This is one of the easiest things to fix with weekly home tuition and one of the last things most students fix on their own.

Paper 2 depends completely on which options your school has selected, which is why we ask for the option list before matching rather than after. A tutor strong in one option is of little practical use for another. The extended answers here are where the judgement question bites hardest: a student who has listed what supports a claim and what undermines it has not yet evaluated anything. Evaluation means saying which way the evidence actually points and why, and then living with that position for the rest of the answer. Mumbai students coming from boards where balance is the marking virtue find this genuinely counterintuitive at first.

Research methodology runs through the whole course and is examined most directly at Higher Level, but methods questions turn up across the papers, which surprises families who have treated methodology as a Paper 3 topic. A student needs to be fluent in what each study type can support: an experiment and the variables it controls, a correlational design and the causal claim it cannot make, a case study and the limits of generalising from one person, an interview and the influence of the person asking. That same fluency underpins the experimental study internal assessment (IA), a separate school-supervised project with its own rules, which is why methods teaching pays twice.
bullets: Paper 1 works the biological, cognitive and sociocultural approaches
Paper 2 is tied to the specific options your school chose to teach
Higher Level Paper 3 examines research thinking on unseen material
Short answers reward compactness; background paragraphs waste paper time
Methods questions appear across papers, not only at Higher Level

sections.heading: Home tuition across the six zones of Mumbai, and what travel does to a timetable
paragraphs: Home tuition lives or dies on whether the tutor can repeat the journey forty times. In South Mumbai, where a large share of our Psychology requests originate, the distances are small and the clock is not: Malabar Hill, Walkeshwar, Breach Candy, Nepean Sea Road, Colaba, Cuffe Parade, Fort, Tardeo, Worli, Prabhadevi and Lower Parel are all within a few kilometres of each other, and an evening crossing through the Peddar Road and Haji Ali signals still eats forty minutes. The Coastal Road has changed the north-south run and Metro Line 3 is changing the Cuffe Parade to BKC trip, but we still match inside the island rather than bringing a tutor down the Bandra-Worli Sea Link at six in the evening.

The Central and Eastern Suburbs are the second cluster and the one with the most awkward geography. Powai and Chandivali hang off JVLR with no station of their own, reached by road from Andheri East, Kanjurmarg or Ghatkopar; Kurla and Ghatkopar sit on the Central Line and Metro Line 1; the Santacruz-Chembur Link Road is the connector everyone forgets until they need it. Further east, Chembur, Govandi, Vikhroli, Bhandup, Mulund West and Wadala are strung along the Central and Harbour lines and the Eastern Express Highway, with the Eastern Freeway making the run into town faster than any Chembur parent expects the first time. A Powai tutor covering Mulund is realistic; a Powai tutor covering Bandra twice a week is not.

The Western Suburbs run in a strip along the Western Line and the Western Express Highway: Bandra West, Khar West, Santacruz West, Vile Parle, Juhu, Andheri East, Jogeshwari, Goregaon East, Malad, Kandivali East, Borivali and Dahisar East. Metro Lines 2A and 7 have made the northern stretch predictable in a way Link Road never was, and matching along the line beats matching across it every time. Parents here often begin with the phrase IB tutors near me Mumbai throws back at them, which works for a common subject and rarely works for Psychology, where the specialist may be four stations away and worth the wait for a later slot.

Navi Mumbai and Thane are matched internally almost without exception. Navi Mumbai runs as nodes, Airoli, Vashi, Sanpada, Nerul, Seawoods, Belapur, Kharghar and Panvel, linked by Palm Beach Road and the Sion-Panvel Highway, with the Harbour and Trans-Harbour lines and the Atal Setu connecting outward; a tutor crossing the creek for a weekday lesson gives up by the third month. Thane spreads from Thane West and Vartak Nagar out along Pokhran Road, Majiwada, Kolshet and Ghodbunder Road to Kasarvadavali, and that last stretch sets everything: twenty minutes at noon, close to an hour at eight. Psychology is taught in fewer schools across Mumbai, Maharashtra than the larger group 3 subjects, so in these two zones we are often choosing between a local generalist and a specialist who will only work online.

Central Suburbs: Powai, Chandivali, Kurla, Ghatkopar, Kanjurmarg off JVLR
Eastern Suburbs: Chembur, Govandi, Vikhroli, Bhandup, Mulund West, Wadala
Western Suburbs: Bandra West, Vile Parle, Jogeshwari, Malad, Kandivali East, Borivali

sections.heading: Which months in the Mumbai school year decide your Psychology grade
paragraphs: The Mumbai IB calendar opens in late June and the pressure arrives in a pattern families can plan for. October and November of DP1 bring the first serious written assessments across all six subjects at once. The second half of DP1 brings the experimental study set-up alongside TOK work. January and February of DP2 bring the mocks, which is when most of our Psychology enquiries arrive and when the least time remains to use them well. Then the May session, or November for students on that cycle, and the year is over faster than the calendar suggests.

Families at B.D. Somani International School in Cuffe Parade, Cathedral and John Connon School in Fort, Bombay International School at Babulnath, Aditya Birla World Academy in Tardeo, Ryan Global School in Worli, JBCN International School in Parel, Ascend International School and the American School of Bombay in BKC, Utpal Shanghvi Global School in Juhu, Thakur International School in Kandivali East, Singapore International School in Dahisar East, NES International School in Mulund West and D.Y. Patil International School in Nerul are all working to that broad shape, with their own internal deadlines layered on top. IB Gram is an independent platform, not affiliated with any of these schools, with any examination board, or with the International Baccalaureate organisation. We name them because their calendars are the real constraint on when a tutor can be useful.

The practical consequence is that exam technique work has a season. Starting it in September of DP2 is sensible; starting it in March of DP2 means the student will practise under more pressure than they can learn from. We tell February callers the truth, which is that six or seven weeks can meaningfully change how a student handles a command term and will not rebuild two years of option content. Some families take that and book anyway, which is a reasonable decision made with open eyes, and some decide to wait and use the time on the subjects where the return is larger.

Monsoon deserves its own sentence because it quietly wrecks home tuition timetables. From June to September a heavy evening in Mumbai turns the Western Express Highway into a queue, floods the tracks around Sion and Kurla, and converts a 6.30pm home visit into a message at 6.15. Over a DP1 year that can mean five cancelled sessions, which in a technique-led plan is five essays not written and not marked. Build a fallback into the arrangement from the start: if the tutor cannot reach you, the session runs online on the same evening rather than being rescheduled into a week that has no space.

Experimental study set-up collides with TOK in the back half of DP1

Technique work started in September of DP2 beats technique work started in March
Agree a monsoon fallback: same evening online, not a rescheduled week

sections.heading: Should Psychology home tuition in Mumbai be weekly, fortnightly or online?
paragraphs: Weekly is the default and it is the default for a reason: technique is a habit, and habits need a deadline every seven days. An IB home tutor in Mumbai coming once a week sets a written task, marks it, and makes the student rewrite the weakest paragraph in front of them. That rhythm is what produces change, and it is what most families picture when they ask for IB DP Psychology home tuition in Mumbai. Psychology home classes Mumbai families arrange usually settle at ninety minutes rather than sixty, because a timed written piece plus marking plus a rewrite does not compress into an hour, and a travelling tutor is not well used doing forty-five minutes of talking.

Fortnightly works for a specific kind of student and fails for everybody else. It works for a disciplined DP2 candidate who will write two full responses unsupervised between visits and genuinely wants the marking rather than the company. It fails for a student who needs the appointment to generate the work, which is most of them, and the failure shows up as a tutor arriving to find nothing written and an hour spent re-explaining instead of marking. Be honest with yourself about which student you have before choosing the cheaper option.

Online is a real alternative here, not a consolation prize, and the trade-offs are specific. An IB online tutor in Mumbai can be chosen for having taught your exact Paper 2 option rather than for living nearby, slots run later in the evening because nobody is driving home, and marking can happen between sessions. What is lost is the handwriting: the examinations are written by hand and a student who only types will discover the difference during the mock. The arrangement many of our DP2 families end up with is weekly in person with one online marking session a fortnight, or the reverse for a Kharghar or Kasarvadavali family where travel never really worked.

A note on who is in the room. Some families want an IB private tutor Mumbai parents hired directly and want them at the dining table where the work is visible; others find a teenager writes better without an adult hovering. Both are defensible. What is not defensible is paying a travelling tutor to supervise silent reading. If the student needs supervision rather than teaching, a study-hall arrangement is cheaper and a home tutor for Psychology Mumbai rates will not be justified by it.
bullets: Weekly beats fortnightly for any student who needs the deadline
Ninety minutes fits a timed piece, marking and a rewrite; sixty does not
Online buys option specialists and later slots, costs handwriting practice
Hybrid: in person weekly, one online marking session a fortnight
Do not pay a travelling tutor to supervise silent reading

sections.heading: How do you check that a Psychology tutor can actually mark to the scheme?
paragraphs: Ask them to mark one of your child's answers in front of you and justify every mark against the published criteria. That single request separates a genuine Psychology tutor in Mumbai from a confident graduate faster than any certificate, because the criteria are public, the reasoning has to be shown, and a tutor who marks by feel cannot do it twice the same way.

What we verify before anyone reaches a shortlist is identity, the qualification claimed, and the teaching history behind the claim of DP experience, checked with the references named rather than taken on trust. For this subject we also ask for marked work with the comments visible. Beyond that, an IB tutor Mumbai families have already used and renewed is a stronger signal than any new profile, and we say so plainly when a shortlist contains both.

There are four questions worth asking in the first fortnight, and they take ten minutes. Which Paper 2 options have you taught, and to which year groups. Show me how you would mark this paragraph. What do you do with a student who retells a study instead of using it. How much writing do you expect between sessions. A tutor who expects no writing has just described a conversation class. Also be wary of a tutor who offers a guaranteed grade: no honest teacher can promise a specific result, and anyone who promises one has told you how they handle uncertainty. IB Gram does not guarantee grades either, and no tutor on this platform is permitted to.

One boundary matters more in Psychology than anywhere else, and it should be said without softening. A DP Psychology tutor teaches an empirical academic science: research design, evidence, and writing under examination conditions. They are not a counsellor, not a therapist, and not qualified to advise on anyone's mental health, and nothing in the syllabus makes them so. If a student is distressed, about the course or about anything else, the school counsellor or a qualified professional is the right route and a tutor is not. A tutor's correct response is to say that clearly to the parent and keep teaching the subject.
bullets: Make the tutor mark a paragraph aloud against the published criteria
Identity, qualification and DP teaching history checked with named referees
Ask which Paper 2 options they have taught and to which year groups
Be wary of promises about a specific grade or a guaranteed improvement
Academic tutor, never a counsellor: distress goes to a qualified professional

sections.heading: What does a home tuition hour drill, paper by paper?
paragraphs: It drills seven things, and the first one is the command term. Every question in DP Psychology opens with an instruction, and that instruction, not the topic, decides the shape of the answer. Describe wants an account. Outline wants a summary. Explain wants reasons. Discuss wants a range considered. Evaluate wants a judgement. Contrast wants differences held side by side. To what extent wants a position with a degree attached to it. A student who reads the topic and ignores the verb writes a good answer to a question nobody asked, and the marks follow the question.

The second is evaluation that reaches a conclusion. Most Mumbai students arrive having been taught that balance is the virtue, so they produce a tidy column of strengths and a tidy column of limitations and stop. That is a list, not an evaluation. A tutor's job is to make the student finish the sentence: given all of that, which way does the evidence point, and how confident should we be. The third follows from it, and it is the single biggest marker of a strong script: using a study as evidence for a particular argument rather than retelling it. The retelling habit is deeply rooted, because retelling feels like knowledge, and the cure is mechanical. Take a study the student has written up at length and make them deploy the same study in two sentences for two different claims.

Fourth is the short-answer work, where the reward is precision and the enemy is throat-clearing. Students who write well at length often write badly short, opening with a sentence of context that the question did not ask for. Fifth is the research-methods thread. Methods questions appear across the papers and not only in the Higher Level paper, and they are answerable from principle rather than memory, which makes them the most improvable marks on the page for a student who has understood what each study type can and cannot show.

Sixth is writing to the mark allocation under real time pressure. The marks attached to a question are the examiner telling you how much to write; check the current paper and your school's guidance for what those allocations are, then practise against them with a clock on the table. Most students discover that they are generous with the cheap questions and rushed on the expensive ones, and that the fix is arithmetic rather than talent. Seventh, and the one students resist most, is the two-minute plan. Two minutes spent deciding the position and the order before the first sentence saves more marks than any amount of extra content, because an essay that changes its mind in the third paragraph cannot be rescued at the end.

All seven come together in the exercise that should happen regularly in IB DP Psychology home tuition in Mumbai: the student marks their own script. Not the tutor marking it and handing it back, which produces nodding; the student marking it against the real criteria with the tutor asking why each mark was awarded. It is slow and it is uncomfortable and it is the fastest route from knowing the content to scoring it, because a student who can mark can see their own writing the way the examiner will.
bullets: Command term decides the structure before the topic decides the content
Evaluation reaches a judgement; strengths and weaknesses lists do not
Same study deployed in two sentences for two different claims
Methods questions are answerable from principle, so they improve fastest
Two minutes planning, then the student marks their own script

sections.heading: Progress at four weeks, one term and one exam cycle in Mumbai
paragraphs: At four weeks, the honest measure is not a grade. It is whether the student now reads the command term first and can say what it is asking before writing anything, and whether their answers have stopped opening with a paragraph of context. Both are visible in the script within a month if the work between sessions is actually being done.

At one term the target is a complete timed response that takes a position and holds it, written without the tutor present, and the ability to look at a past question and say what it would cost to answer it well. By this point the student should also be able to cut their own work, which sounds minor and is the skill most closely associated with improved scripts. If a full term of weekly home tuition has produced no change in the writing, the arrangement is not working and that conversation should happen immediately rather than at the mock.

Across a full examination cycle the realistic aim is to close the distance between what the student knows and what reaches the page. For a student who already has the content, that distance is where most of the available marks sit. For a student who is also missing content, the plan has to be sequenced differently, content first and technique layered on, and the timeline is longer; pretending otherwise just produces a polished answer about nothing.

The limits are as important as the targets and we would rather set them now. IB Gram does not guarantee grades, and neither does any tutor working through the platform; too much depends on the student, the school, the session and the day itself. Weekly sessions with no writing in between will not move an essay subject whoever is teaching. A student beginning in March of DP2 can sharpen technique and cannot acquire two years of material. And if the obstacle is not academic, more tuition is the wrong response entirely; that belongs with the school counsellor or a qualified professional, not with a Psychology tutor.
bullets: Four weeks: command term read first, context paragraphs gone
One term: a timed response written alone that holds a position
One cycle: the gap between knowledge and script narrows
No writing between sessions means no movement in an essay subject
Non-academic obstacles belong with a qualified professional, not a tutor

sections.heading: Booking the first session: what to have ready
paragraphs: Three documents and one honest sentence. The most recent marked Psychology script, with the teacher's comments intact, because that is what the first session works on. The school's Paper 2 option list, which the student will know. The term calendar showing mock dates and internal deadlines. And one sentence from the parent about what they actually think is wrong, even if it is only a feeling, because parents are usually closer to right than they expect.

The first session runs in your home and is diagnostic. The tutor reads the script with the student, finds the point where the answer stopped serving the question, and sets one timed piece before leaving. There should be written work set at the end of the first visit without exception; a first session that ends with a plan and no task has not started yet. Expect the student to be fairly quiet afterwards, and expect the second session to be more useful than the first.

Practical arrangements are worth settling in the same conversation rather than discovering later. Where the student will work, which is ideally a table in a shared room rather than a bedroom. Whether your society needs a visitor entry arranged in advance. Whether the slot survives the monsoon or needs an online fallback. And whether you want the parent in the room, which is a decision with no universally right answer and is better made deliberately than by accident. Settle the payment rhythm in the same conversation too, monthly or per session, so that nobody is having a billing discussion in the middle of mock fortnight when attention is needed elsewhere.
bullets: Have the latest marked script, the option list and the term calendar ready
First visit is diagnostic and must end with a timed task set
Agree the work table, ideally in a shared room rather than a bedroom
Sort society visitor entry before the first weekday evening slot
Decide deliberately whether a parent sits in, rather than by default

faqs.question: How long should a home tuition session be for DP Psychology?
faqs.answer: Ninety minutes suits this subject better than sixty. A useful session contains a timed written piece, marking of that piece against the criteria, and a rewrite of the weakest paragraph, and that sequence does not fit into an hour once the tutor has arrived and settled. Sixty minutes works for a short diagnostic check-in or for a student who is writing a great deal independently and only needs marking. For most students taking IB DP Psychology home tuition in Mumbai we suggest one ninety minute session a week rather than two short ones, which also makes the journey worth the tutor's time.

faqs.question: Will a tutor travel to Chembur or Wadala for a weekday evening slot?
faqs.answer: Yes, and the Eastern Suburbs are among the easier zones to staff for evening work. Tutors living in Chembur, Govandi, Vikhroli or Mulund West move along the Central and Harbour lines and the Eastern Express Highway without much trouble, and the Eastern Freeway makes a Wadala or Chembur address reachable from the island city faster than most people assume. What we avoid is booking a Western Suburbs tutor into a 7pm Chembur slot; that journey looks fine on a map in August and collapses in October.

faqs.question: What does our society gate need from a tutor who visits every week?
faqs.answer: Usually a standing entry rather than a fresh approval each time, and arranging it in advance saves ten minutes a week for a year. Most Mumbai complexes will register a regular visitor once the resident confirms it, either in the gate register or through the society's visitor app, and some ask for an identity document on the first visit. Tell us if your building needs anything specific, because a tutor who is stopped at the gate every Tuesday eventually stops being punctual. Tutors carry identification and are told to expect the check.

faqs.question: Do IB tuition fees in Mumbai change for Higher Level Psychology?
faqs.answer: Generally yes, and we would rather explain the drivers than pretend a single rate exists. Fees respond to board and level, because Higher Level Diploma Programme work needs a more experienced tutor; to subject scarcity, which places Psychology above the widely taught subjects in most quotes here; to session length, since ninety minutes of marked writing is not simply an hour and a half; to travel distance, which is why identical lessons cost differently in Colaba and Kharghar; and to whether marking between sessions is included, which in this subject is the part actually worth paying for.

faqs.question: My daughter knows everything and still loses marks. Why?
faqs.answer: Almost always because she is answering the topic rather than the instruction. A question that says evaluate is asking for a judgement, and an answer that supplies a well-organised account of everything known about the topic will not collect those marks however accurate it is. The second most common cause is retelling studies at length instead of using them as evidence for a claim. Both are technique problems, both respond quickly to weekly marked practice, and neither is fixed by more revision, which is usually what a conscientious student does instead.

faqs.question: What is the real difference between describe, explain and evaluate?
faqs.answer: They demand three different things and misreading them is the commonest avoidable loss in the subject. Describe asks for an account of what something is, with no reasons required. Explain asks why, so the answer must contain causal reasoning rather than more detail. Evaluate asks for a judgement supported by evidence, which means weighing material and then committing to a position. A student who writes a strong description in response to an evaluate question has written something a teacher would praise and an examiner cannot reward. Practising the same content against all three verbs fixes it fast.

faqs.question: Should exam practice start in DP1 or wait until DP2?
faqs.answer: Start in DP1, in small pieces, from the second term. Waiting until DP2 means learning technique while also carrying the internal assessment, TOK and the other five subjects, which is the worst possible moment to acquire a new habit. The DP1 version does not need full papers: one short timed answer a fortnight, marked properly, is enough to build the reflex of reading the command term first. By DP2 that student is practising full responses rather than discovering what the instructions mean.

faqs.question: Can a tutor mark my son's paper using the real mark scheme?
faqs.answer: Yes, and they should, using the published assessment criteria for the component rather than a personal impression. The more valuable exercise, though, is the reverse: the student marks their own script against those criteria while the tutor asks why each decision was made. Students who can mark start to see their writing from the examiner's side, which is the point at which scripts improve without being told. Your school can supply the current criteria, and a tutor who has not asked for them within the first fortnight is not doing this properly.

faqs.question: What if my son refuses to plan before he writes?
faqs.answer: Make the plan the only thing he submits for two weeks. Most students resist planning because it feels like time lost from writing, and the resistance disappears once they see a marked plan score better than a marked essay that wandered. A two minute plan that fixes the position and the order of the argument prevents the commonest structural failure in DP Psychology, which is an answer that quietly changes its mind halfway through. Setting plans alone, without the essay attached, removes the perceived cost and builds the habit in a fortnight.

faqs.question: The school already gives feedback. What does a tutor add?
faqs.answer: Volume and repetition, mostly. A DP teacher with a full timetable cannot mark several drafts per student per term, so school feedback tends to arrive on finished work at intervals. Technique changes through frequent marking of short pieces, which is exactly the thing a timetable cannot provide and a weekly session can. A tutor should work with the school's feedback rather than around it, which is why we ask for the marked script: if the teacher has already identified the problem, the tuition should be drilling that, not starting a parallel diagnosis.

faqs.question: What happens if the tutor and my child simply do not get along?
faqs.answer: Tell us in week two rather than in February. Personality mismatch is common, costs nothing to fix early, and costs a term if endured. Send the specific problem rather than a general impression, because precision improves the second shortlist: talks too much, sets no written work, marks too kindly, cannot explain a lost mark. We send a replacement shortlist, there is no notice period and no penalty, and the only genuine cost is the couple of weeks a new tutor needs to learn how your child writes.

sections.heading: How IB Gram matches a home tutor for Psychology Mumbai families actually need
paragraphs: The enquiry usually arrives in a particular week. The class has been told to start thinking about the experimental study, the student has an idea they are excited about, the teacher has said it will not work, and nobody at home can see why. That is the right moment to call and the wrong moment to panic. Most of the problem is not effort or ability. It is that the student has understood the task as inventing an experiment, when the task is replicating one that has already been published and carefully narrowing it to something a school can actually run.

So the first thing we ask for is the idea in the student's own words, plus whatever the teacher wrote back. Those two things together tell a specialist more than a transcript. If the teacher's comment mentions the published study, the student needs help with sourcing and reading research. If it mentions feasibility or participants, the issue is scope. If it mentions ethics, the conversation is different again and has to run through the school. Each of those routes to a different tutor and a different first session, and sending the wrong one wastes a fortnight nobody has spare.

Practical filters come next: the Diploma Programme (DP) year, the examination session, the school and its own internal deadline for the study, the free evenings, and where you live, because a tutor who cannot reach Kandivali East by seven on a Thursday in July should not be offered that slot. You receive two or three profiles with travel described realistically. The first home tuition session is diagnostic rather than productive: the tutor asks the student to explain the proposed study aloud, finds the point where it stops being testable, and writes you a short note setting out what has to be settled first and in what order.

sections.heading: Does the experimental study differ at Standard Level and Higher Level?
paragraphs: In its essentials, no. Standard Level (SL) and Higher Level (HL) students both plan and carry out a simple experimental study based on a published piece of research, analyse what they collected and write it up against the same criteria. Higher Level students carry more content elsewhere in the course and an additional written paper, which changes the time available rather than the nature of the task. Parents sometimes hope that a move down to Standard Level will make the study easier. It does not. It makes the rest of the week easier, which is a real benefit, but the report in front of the student is the same piece of work.

What does differ is how much the study teaches you. At Higher Level the unseen research material in the additional paper rewards exactly the habits the study builds: reading a method critically, asking what a design permits a researcher to claim, noticing what was measured rather than what was intended. Students who treat their own study as a form to be completed arrive at that paper with nothing transferable. Students who argue with their own design while writing it up find the paper far more answerable. Families looking for a Psychology IB Diploma Programme (DP), Years 1-2 tutor Mumbai schools would recognise are usually looking for someone who can make that connection explicit rather than teaching the two things separately.

Timing is governed by the school rather than by the International Baccalaureate (IB). Each school sets its own proposal deadline, its own ethics approval step, its own data collection window and its own draft dates, and those internal dates sit well ahead of anything the board publishes. The Diploma Programme coordinator or the subject teacher is the only reliable source for them, and they should be collected in writing at the start of DP1 rather than reconstructed from memory in DP2. Every sensible plan for this subject is built backwards from the school's draft date, not forwards from today.

sections.heading: Papers 1, 2 and 3, and why the experimental study feeds all three
paragraphs: Paper 1 examines the approaches to understanding behaviour, Paper 2 examines the option the school has chosen to teach, and Paper 3 at Higher Level puts unseen research material in front of the student and asks what can reasonably be concluded from it. The experimental study is not a separate project bolted onto that. It is the only part of the course where the student produces evidence instead of evaluating somebody else's, which is why doing it properly improves every written paper.

The connection is concrete. A student who has personally wrestled with how to operationalise a variable stops writing vague sentences about what a study measured. A student who has recruited participants in their own school understands sampling limitations from the inside and can write about them without reciting a textbook phrase. A student who has chosen a statistical treatment and then had to explain what the result does and does not show has acquired the exact caution that evaluation questions reward. None of that transfers if the report was assembled from a template the week before it was due.

Ask the school early which option the class is being taught, because tutoring prepared on a different option is close to worthless and the mismatch is not always obvious until a month in. Ask also whether the teacher wants the study drawn from a particular area of the syllabus, since some departments steer students towards the content being taught that term so the write-up and the lessons reinforce each other.

The IB revises its subject guides on its own cycle, so the papers offered, the options available and the exact requirements of the internal assessment for the session your child sits should be confirmed from the current guide through the school rather than from any tutoring page, this one included. What does not change is the character of the work: evidence, method, and a judgement the student can defend.
bullets: Paper 1 covers the approaches; Paper 2 covers only your school's option.

sections.heading: Where does an IB home tutor in Mumbai sit down with a DP student?
paragraphs: At your table, in every zone, with the practical caveat that corridors rather than kilometres decide which evenings are realistic. The Western Suburbs carry the largest share of these requests. Bandra, Khar West, Santacruz, Juhu, Andheri West, Oshiwara, Goregaon, Malad, Kandivali East, Borivali and Dahisar sit along the Western Line, Metro Lines 2A and 7, the Western Express Highway and Link Road, with the Bandra-Worli Sea Link taking the southbound traffic. Matching along that spine works. Pulling a tutor across it at six in the evening does not, and a study with a fixed data collection window is exactly the wrong project to run on an unreliable slot.

Navi Mumbai is the other concentration, and it behaves differently from the island city. Vashi, Nerul, Seawoods, Belapur, Kharghar and Panvel are planned nodes connected by Palm Beach Road and the Sion-Panvel Highway, with the Harbour and Trans-Harbour lines and the Navi Mumbai Metro between them, so a tutor living in Nerul can serve Seawoods and Belapur comfortably. The Atal Setu has genuinely changed weekend travel from the island, though a weekday evening crossing of the creek is still a slot that fails by November. In the Central Suburbs, Kurla, Ghatkopar, Vikhroli, Kanjurmarg and Mulund run along the Central Line and the Eastern Express Highway, while Powai and Chandivali are reached only by road on JVLR, and Metro Line 1 and the Santacruz-Chembur Link Road do the east to west work.

South Mumbai is matched within itself across Colaba, Cuffe Parade, Churchgate, Breach Candy, Walkeshwar, Tardeo, Peddar Road and Worli, where the Coastal Road and Metro Line 3 have improved the north to south run but the Peddar Road signals still decide the arrival. The Eastern Suburbs cover Chembur, Govandi, Wadala, Bhandup and Mulund West on the Central and Harbour lines, with the Eastern Freeway making the run to Fort quicker than most residents of Mumbai, Maharashtra expect. Thane spreads from the station across Pokhran Road and Majiwada out along Ghodbunder Road to Kasarvadavali, and that road, not the map, writes the timetable there.

Searches like IB tutors near me Mumbai will give you a radius. For this particular task the radius is less important than whether the tutor has taken a student through an experimental study before, because the failure modes are specific and unfamiliar ones cost weeks. An IB DP psychology home tutor in Mumbai who has supervised three of these is worth a longer commute than a nearer generalist, and where that trade is too severe we propose a hybrid shape rather than pretending the travel will hold.

paragraphs: The students we see for this are typically at Jamnabai Narsee International School or Ecole Mondiale World School in Juhu, Oberoi International School on JVLR in Goregaon East, Hiranandani Foundation School in Powai, Thakur International School in Kandivali East, JBCN International School in Parel, Singapore International School in Dahisar East, the American School of Bombay and Ascend International School in BKC, Activity High School on Peddar Road, Gopi Birla Memorial School in Walkeshwar, Bombay Cambridge International School in Andheri East, Billabong High International School in Juhu or Thane, and D.Y. Patil International School in Nerul. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any of these schools, with any examination board, or with the International Baccalaureate organisation. They appear here because Mumbai families attend them and because their internal calendars decide when the pressure arrives.

The year an IB tutor Mumbai families book has to work around opens in June, and for this subject the first real checkpoint is the study proposal, usually somewhere in the second half of DP1. That proposal has to clear the teacher and then the school's ethics process, and both steps take longer than students budget for. A proposal rejected in its first form is completely normal and is not a setback; a proposal submitted three days before the deadline, rejected, and then resubmitted in a rush is how students end up running a study they do not believe in.

The second squeeze comes after the Diwali break, when data collection has to happen inside school time with real participants whose own timetables are full. A DP1 student in Kandivali East who needs thirty minutes each from a number of classmates is competing with mocks, rehearsals, sports fixtures and every other subject's internal assessment for those same thirty minutes. Booking the data collection into the school diary early is worth more than any amount of weekend work.

Then the write-up collides with everything else. A DP2 student in Vashi sitting the May session will commonly be redrafting the study in the same fortnight as the Theory of Knowledge (TOK) essay upload and an Extended Essay (EE) checkpoint, with another subject's internal assessment due alongside. The families who come through that fortnight calmly are the ones who finished data collection before it. That is the entire trick, and it is decided nine months earlier.

sections.heading: Why IB home tuition in Mumbai suits the experimental study better than online
paragraphs: Home tutoring leads for this work because the study is paperwork as much as psychology, and paperwork is faster across a table. A home tutor spreads out the published study, the student's draft, the school's criteria and the teacher's comments at once, and moves between them with a pencil. On a screen that same comparison becomes three tabs and a lost thread. The other advantage is less obvious: in a home tuition session a tutor can see which sentence the student wrote confidently and which one they copied without understanding, because the student hesitates when asked to read it aloud. That signal is the whole academic honesty safeguard, and it is clearer in the room.

The honest trade-offs are the usual ones. Travel is priced into what a tutor charges, so an evening slot in Kharghar from a Vashi-based tutor costs differently from one around the corner. A cancelled visit is harder to reschedule than a cancelled call. And the pool of tutors who have actually supervised this study and can reach your area on a weekday is smaller than the pool across the city, which occasionally means waiting a week for the right person rather than taking the available one.

Online earns its place at specific moments. An IB online tutor in Mumbai is the better option for a quick check on a results table, for a fifteen-minute conversation about whether a hypothesis is stated correctly, or during the weeks when data collection means the student is busy at school rather than at home. Screen sharing is genuinely better for walking through a spreadsheet than leaning over one. Its weaknesses show in long drafting sessions, where attention drifts, and in monsoon weeks when connections drop mid-sentence.

Most families run a hybrid once the study is underway, and for an IB DP psychology home tutor in Mumbai that arrangement holds up across two years far better than a rigid weekly visit. One home session a week for drafting and method teaching, one short online check between sessions when a deadline is close, and the flexibility to swap one for the other when the Western Express Highway floods. Reliability over eighteen months matters more than the format of any single lesson.
bullets: Paper, draft, criteria and teacher comments compare faster across one table.
Reading a draft aloud at home exposes sentences the student did not write.
Psychology home classes Mumbai families book usually run once or twice weekly.

sections.heading: What is a Psychology tutor in Mumbai checked on before you meet them?
paragraphs: Identity, qualification and subject-specific teaching history, in that order, before any profile reaches a parent. For an IB DP psychology home tutor in Mumbai we weight one thing above the rest: whether they have taken a student's experimental study from proposal through ethics approval, data collection and analysis to a submitted report. Somebody who has done that three times knows where students fail. Somebody with an excellent degree and no supervision experience will teach good psychology and miss the two or three procedural traps that cost the marks.

What we verify is specific. Government photo identity. The qualification claimed. The teaching record claimed, with a reference contacted where one is available. A subject conversation about this course and this internal assessment rather than about psychology in general. And which option the tutor has taught, since that mismatch is the most common waste of a parent's money in this subject. What we do not do is also stated plainly: we do not run police verification on your behalf and do not claim to. Decide what further checks you want for someone entering your home and make them.

There is a boundary that matters more here than almost anywhere, and any tutor worth hiring will raise it before you do. A tutor may teach the method, explain a criterion, model how a results section is structured and comment on a draft the student has written themselves. A tutor may not write any part of the report, draft a single paragraph to be submitted, supply data, run the analysis on the student's behalf, or produce the references. The student's work has to be the student's. Where a tutor crosses that line, the person exposed is the candidate, not the tutor, and the consequence sits with the school and the board.

A second boundary belongs to this subject in particular. Tutoring is academic teaching, not counselling and not therapy, and a tutor is not a mental health professional. If a student is struggling personally, the school counsellor is the right first conversation and can route the family to a qualified professional. A tutor is not that route and should say so and stop. Finally, be wary of anyone offering a guaranteed grade on the first call. We do not guarantee grades, and the people who promise a specific number are the same ones who offer to help a little too much with the write-up.
bullets: Identity, qualification and teaching history checked before any profile appears.
Ask how many experimental studies the tutor has supervised to submission.
Tutors may mark a student's draft; they may not write or supply data.
Counselling belongs with the school counsellor, never with a subject tutor.
We do not run police verification and we do not claim to.

sections.heading: The experimental study, step by step: replication, hypothesis, method, ethics, statistics
paragraphs: Start with the constraint that surprises everyone: the study must be based on a published piece of research rather than invented. Students read this as a restriction on creativity and resent it for about a week. It exists for good reasons. A published study has already shown that the effect is detectable with modest numbers and simple equipment, that the task can be explained to a participant in a minute, and that somebody has already thought about whether it is safe and reasonable to run. A student inventing a study from scratch usually produces something that cannot be measured, cannot be completed in a lunch break, or cannot be approved. Working from an existing study replaces a term of guesswork with a known starting point, and all the genuine thinking moves to how the replication is adapted and what the result means.

The hypothesis is where most proposals die, and it is almost always the same fault: it is interesting but not testable. A testable hypothesis names what will be manipulated, names what will be measured, states the direction of the expected difference, and is specific enough that two people reading it would collect identical data. If the student cannot say what number or score they will write down for each participant, the hypothesis is not finished. A useful home exercise is to write the blank results table before writing the hypothesis. If the table cannot be drawn, the design is not yet real, and that single trick has saved more proposals than any amount of reading.

The method has one test: could a competent stranger repeat this exactly from your description, without asking you a question. That means the materials are listed and reproduced, the instructions given to participants are written out word for word rather than summarised, the conditions are described in the order they happened, and anything that was standardised is stated as such. Students routinely write that participants were given a word list and omit how long they saw it, in what order, and what they were told to do while waiting. Each omission is a hole a reader falls into. Reading the method aloud to a parent who knows nothing about the subject is the cheapest possible check, and it is exactly the sort of thing a home tutor sets as a task between sessions.

Ethics is not a form and it is not the tutor's call. The school approves the study, and the school's guidelines decide what is permitted, which participants are acceptable and what has to be in writing. The requirements are real constraints on the design, not boxes: informed consent obtained before anything begins, a clear and genuine right to withdraw at any point including after taking part, a debrief that tells participants what the study was actually about, and no deception beyond what the school has specifically approved in advance. Vulnerable participants are out, and the school defines that category rather than the student. Nothing may be arranged independently of the school, which means no recruiting through a residents' group, no collecting data at home over a weekend because the week ran out, and no quiet substitution of participants the teacher has not approved. A study run outside the approved process is not a study with a problem; it is data that cannot be used.

Choose the statistical treatment before a single data point is collected, not after. This is the most commonly ignored instruction in the whole task and the most expensive. The test that is appropriate follows from the design and from what kind of data is being recorded, so deciding it in advance forces the student to confirm that their design can actually answer their hypothesis. Working the other way round, collecting first and then hunting for a test that produces a tidy outcome, is both bad practice and visible to an examiner. Agree the intended treatment with the teacher at the proposal stage, write it into the plan, and then report what it gave you, including when the result is unremarkable. A study with no detectable difference, honestly analysed and honestly discussed, is worth more than a study with a dramatic result and a shaky method.

The discussion is where the marks concentrate and where tired students write least. Its job is to relate the result back to the original published study: did the replication find something consistent with it, and if not, what in your adapted method could account for the difference. Sample, setting, the age and background of participants, the time of day, the modifications made to fit a school timetable, all of these are legitimate explanations and naming them precisely is the skill being assessed. Then the limitations, written as specific features of what was actually done rather than as a generic list, and finally what a sensible next study would change. A student who can say why their own design made a particular conclusion unsafe has demonstrated exactly what the course is about.

Two final notes. There is no best IB tutor in Mumbai for this task in the abstract; there is a tutor who has watched three students make these mistakes and can see the fourth coming. And the division of labour is not negotiable: the tutor teaches the method, explains the criteria and comments on what the student has written, while the student writes every word of it. A report produced any other way is academic misconduct, and the consequence lands on the candidate.
bullets: Replicate a published study: it is already shown to be measurable.
Draw the blank results table before finalising the hypothesis.
Write instructions to participants word for word, not as a summary.
Ethics is approved by the school; nothing is arranged independently of it.
Pick the statistical treatment at proposal stage, before collecting data.
The discussion must relate your result back to the original study.

sections.heading: What should an IB DP psychology home tutor in Mumbai change in four weeks?
paragraphs: Four weeks in, the visible change should be in how the student talks about their own work. They should be able to state their hypothesis in one sentence without hedging, say what they are measuring and how, and name the published study they are working from along with what they have changed about it. They should also have a written plan with the school's dates on it. None of that is a grade, and nobody should be offering you one at four weeks. If those four things are not in place after a month of weekly sessions, the diagnosis or the match is wrong and we want to hear about it then rather than in February.

At one term the measure is documentary. The proposal has cleared the teacher, the ethics step has either been approved or has a clear reason why not, the data collection is booked into the school diary, and a first draft of the introduction and method exists in the student's own words. Alongside that, the written papers should be moving on whatever question types were targeted, and only those. A tutor who spent the term on the study cannot claim credit for an improvement in the option paper, and a parent is entitled to ask which skills were actually worked on.

At one exam cycle you can see whether the method teaching became method thinking. Mocks are the test, especially the unseen research material at Higher Level. Here is the limit stated plainly: a student starting in DP2 with no study underway and a weak grasp of the approaches cannot be carried to a top grade by May, and anyone saying otherwise is selling. Tutoring changes working habits and therefore the odds. It does not create time. We do not guarantee grades, we make no score claims, and we would rather decline an enquiry than agree to a target nobody can honestly commit to.

If the match is not working, two sessions is enough to tell and a term is far too long to endure one out of politeness. Say so and the tutor is replaced with no argument and no case to build. We ask only what specifically did not work, because pace, communication, a gap in the tutor's own experience of the study, or simply the slot each point somewhere different. The first tutor's notes transfer so the student does not repeat a diagnostic they have already sat through once.
bullets: Four weeks: a one-sentence hypothesis and a dated plan, not a grade.
One term: proposal cleared, ethics resolved, data collection in the diary.
One term: a first draft of introduction and method in the student's words.
One exam cycle: mocks show whether method teaching became method thinking.
Two sessions is enough to judge a match; replacement needs no justification.

sections.heading: Getting started with an IB private tutor Mumbai parents can book this week
paragraphs: Send five things and the match gets much sharper. The DP year and the examination session. The school, and the option the class is being taught. Where the study currently stands, in one line: not started, proposal written, proposal rejected, data collected, or drafting. The evenings that are genuinely free. And your area with the nearest station or the road you live off, so travel can be judged rather than guessed. If the teacher has written comments on the proposal, send those too. They are the single most useful document you have.

The first home tuition session is a diagnostic and should be treated as one. Have the published study the student intends to replicate, or the search they have done so far if there is not one yet. Have the school's criteria sheet and its internal deadlines. Have whatever has been written, including the parts the student thinks are bad. Expect the tutor to ask the student to explain the design aloud, to find the point where it stops being testable, and to leave you a written note of what gets settled first. If no note arrives, ask for one before booking a second session.

On money, expect a discussion rather than a price list. IB tuition fees in Mumbai depend on the level, how scarce tutors with real supervision experience are near you, the travel involved, the session length and whether the teaching happens at home or online. Supervision experience for the experimental study is scarcer than general Psychology teaching, and that shows in the rate in most zones. Agree the per-session fee, the session length, the cancellation rule and whether draft feedback between sessions is included, all before the first visit. Do not pay a term in advance to someone you have met once, and do not pay extra to anyone who hints that they will help with the writing itself.
bullets: Send DP year, session, school, taught option and the study's current stage.
Bring the published study, the criteria sheet and the school deadlines.
Send the teacher's written comments on the proposal if they exist.
Agree fee, session length and cancellation terms before the first visit.
